name: skillshelf
description: Standalone AI coding skills: Regwise, Edgecase, Blueprint, Showcase, Casebook. Open Agent Skills format.

plugins.name: regwise
plugins.description: Routes a project to the compliance obligations that actually apply to it, audits a repository against them, and drafts the user-facing legal documents they require.

plugins.name: edgecase
plugins.description: Stable-ID review of the UI states everyone forgets (loading, empty, error, success, partial): 34 rules with Applies lines, split into blocking and non-blocking, applied while the interface is written. A review the model runs before it reports done; it advises and does not enforce.

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Eight skills: a six-stage spec chain that carries one AC-### identifier from idea to shipped code, plus a front door and an opt-in checker.

plugins.name: showcase
plugins.description: Writes a repository README from evidence rather than adjectives — runs the project first, then fills a fixed skeleton with real output, observed numbers, a mermaid diagram of the mechanism, and an identity block whose every badge states a checkable fact. Nothing executes at install; it runs your project's tests or dev server only after a safety gate.

plugins.name: casebook
plugins.description: Hypothesis-driven debugging with a case file in docs/bugs: no code edits until an experiment result is recorded, and a fix counts only when the repro fails before and passes after.
